story: On the third day, the guards came for Mira before sunrise. They put chains on her wrists and took her down into the dark under the hill, where an iron cage hung from the ceiling.
“Iron,” said a voice. “No fae can touch it, so no fae can open it. Not even my brother.”
Corin stepped out of the shadows. Next to him stood Lirra.
“You,” Mira breathed. “You were the servant with the bottle. You wore a glamour.”
Lirra smiled. It was not a kind smile. “I told you I could help you. I never said who I was loyal to.”

“Of course,” said Corin. “The poison, the wolf — all of it. My brother has a weakness, and its name is mortal kindness. Today I will reveal the truth to the whole court: Ash's mortal girl is a traitor who tried to kill him. He will try to rescue you, and I will have my revenge at last.”
They locked the cage and took the key with them.
Mira sat in the dark for a long time. Then she looked at her hands. Iron could not hurt her. The chains were iron. The cage was iron. The lock was iron.
And every child in her village knew how to open an old iron lock with a hairpin.
She smiled for the first time that day.
“I made a vow,” she whispered to nobody. “Seven days. I am not going to die on the third.”

grammar.title: Пересказ чужих слов: said / told
grammar.text:
Когда пересказывают слова, время обычно «сдвигается» в прошлое.

Лирра раньше сказала: “I can help you.”
Теперь она пересказывает: I told you I could help you — «Я говорила, что могу тебе помочь» (can → could).

Так же: will → would, is → was, am → was.

say — просто «сказать»: I never said who I was loyal to.
tell — «сказать кому-то», после него нужен человек: I told you…
